selectionOutcomes.description: Binds the notes action, including POST, to PaperlessNotePermissions.
Binds currentUser to the authenticated request principal used by subsequent checks and note creation.
Loads the addressed document and its owner, preserving the distinction between no owner and a different owner.
Applies the owner-aware view_document check before request-method dispatch.
At the POST branch, applies the owner-aware change_document check before creating a note.
Creates the note only after the POST authorization gate.
Defines the decisive alternatives: owner absent, caller ownership, or an object permission grant.
Shows the enclosing viewset's default authentication and object-permission classes, against which the action-specific override is interpreted.
Defines the global permissions required for POST, including add_note, view_document, and change_document.
Selects the method-specific permission list and requires the authenticated caller to hold all listed global permissions.
